bot_intro: 💎 The easiest way to buy USDT Pay with Syrian Pounds (SYP) or USD via Sham Cash. Fast, seamless integration, real-time order tracking.
terms_text: ━━━ Terms of Service & Disclaimer ━━━ 1. Service Nature This bot serves as a technical intermediary between you and the digital currency exchange service provider. The bot is an order management interface only. 2. Liability - You are solely responsible for the accuracy of the USDT wallet address you enter. - We are not liable for any loss of funds resulting from an incorrect address or wrong network selection. - When saving a wallet address, you bear the responsibility of verifying it before each use. - The bot does not store or directly handle digital currencies. 3. Transactions - The exchange rate is locked at the time of order creation and will not change thereafter. - Estimated processing time: 15 minutes - 24 hours. - Payment via Sham Cash only. - Payment receipt must be submitted within {timeout} minutes of order approval. - All transactions are final once payment is confirmed. - Orders may be rejected if they violate the terms or fail to meet requirements. 4. Privacy - We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data in accordance with this policy. - The data we collect (full name, Telegram ID, username, Sham Cash account number) is used solely for: • Account verification and identity authentication. • Order processing and fulfillment. • Communicating with you regarding your orders. • Improving service quality. - Your data will not be shared, sold, or disclosed to any third party unless required by law. - Your data is stored securely and retained while your account remains active. - Your data belongs to you. You may request its deletion at any time and all your data will be permanently deleted. - We are not responsible for information you share outside the bot's scope. 5. General Provisions - We reserve the right to reject or cancel any order that violates these terms. - We reserve the right to update these terms at any time, with notice of material changes. - Your continued use of the bot after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised terms. - These terms are governed by applicable laws and regulations. 6. Our Commitment to You - We are a team working hard to serve you, not just an automated interface. - Transparency and honesty are the foundation of our work — we handle your money and data as we would our own. - We constantly strive to provide the best possible experience, and your feedback helps us improve every day. - If you face any issue or have a question, our support team is here to help you personally and promptly. - Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we continuously work to improve our service quality. 7. Security & Scam Warning - We will NEVER send you a private message on Telegram for any reason asking you to transfer funds to an external address. - The payment process is conducted exclusively through the bot itself, not via private messages or third parties. - Beware of scam attempts: do not engage with anyone claiming to be from our support team asking you to make a transfer. - If you receive any suspicious message, please report it to us immediately through the official support channels. - We only communicate with you through the official bot and the official email listed in the support section. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ By clicking "Agree", you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted these terms.
